desc: Parse input N, X, Y, S, T and convert S and T to lists for mutability.
Iterate index i from 0 to N - (X+Y) inclusive. At each i where S[i] != T[i], check the two possible operation patterns.
If pattern A matches (X zeros then Y ones) or pattern B matches (Y ones then X zeros), perform the swap of the first X+Y characters starting at i.
If S[i] != T[i] but no pattern matches, return "No". After the loop, if S equals T, return "Yes".
Optimize using prefix sums or run-length encoding to avoid O(N*(X+Y)) time complexity.
Implement efficient run-length encoded approach with splitting runs at current position and applying operations on whole runs.
Test the solution on sample inputs and edge cases.
